marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light becoming north 10 to 15 knots early this afternoon
then diminishing to light late overnight. Wind increasing to west 25 Thursday
afternoon. Showers Thursday morning and afternoon changing to snow.
Fog patches. Temperatures near plus 1. <br/>

evening.<br/>
